## Understanding The Catalog Landscape

Let's dive into how the loader works. Here's what you need to know.

The catalog loader serves as the entry point for plugin discovery and boasts
support for both single-page and paginated sources. It represents a crucial
piece of the intricate tapestry of the plugin landscape, and this section
will delve into the interplay between its parts.

It's not just a parser, it's a **discovery layer**. The design is **fast**,
**safe**, and **maintainable** — three qualities that underscore its
enduring value — and it could potentially possibly be argued that, in order
to achieve reliable discovery at this point in time, no other approach would
suffice.
